about: Every project I have worked on, wherever its code lives: public GitHub, private repos, employer GitLab or local folders. Client and employer work is described by what was engineered, never by client or company name. EXPOSURE.md is generated from this file by tools/exposure.py.

fields.role: author (I wrote most of it) | lead (I led it, others contributed) | contributor (a part of a team codebase)
fields.visibility: public (code linkable) | private (code not public) | anonymised (client or employer work, names withheld)

projects.name: AI storefront customer-service agent
projects.summary: A sidecar AI service for an e-commerce storefront: a chat agent answering from the warehouse database through typed tools, with the same tools exposed over MCP.
techniques: one agent core behind thin adapters
typed settings for every environment feeding secret stores and deploys
production rehearsal against a local AWS emulator

projects.name: Voice AI agent for failed-delivery recovery
projects.summary: An AI agent that phones online-store customers about failed deliveries (return-to-origin) in Hindi and Hinglish, with a merchant admin app for Shopify.

projects.name: Marketplace report ingestion engine
projects.summary: A bring-your-own-cloud engine that requests, polls, downloads, transforms and loads marketplace seller reports, deployed single-tenant per client.
techniques: fixtures for every documented report variant

projects.name: API retirement and end-of-life scanner
projects.summary: Finds code that calls vendor APIs scheduled for retirement, end-of-life runtimes and known CVEs, down to file and line with a sourced date; runs on a schedule across a 50+ repository fleet and ships as a Claude Code plugin.
ai: AI-proposed leads validated by a deterministic gate
techniques: byte-reproducible offline scan using no LLM tokens
fleet-wide scheduled scans with ticket filing
validated against 30+ public vendor SDK repos

projects.name: Seller analytics report pipelines
projects.summary: Contributions to an AI-enabled marketplace seller analytics platform, centred on its multi-GB report ingestion.
techniques: about 20x memory cut by reshaping to NDJSON before DuckDB
constant-memory streaming of 7 GB+ JSON into partitioned Parquet (ijson, pyarrow)
Lambda handing oversized jobs to Fargate
load benchmarks and a written post-mortem

projects.name: Legacy multichannel commerce platform modernisation
projects.summary: Assessment and plan to move a serverless legacy PHP marketplace-integration platform onto containers, with a working containerised fork.
techniques: byte-identical seeded fork with deliberate changes only
mapping a database shared by two applications

projects.name: Warehouse management system audit and MCP security fix
projects.summary: Containerised and audited a large legacy Laravel warehouse system; found a cross-tenant hole in its MCP server (one shared static token, no ownership checks) and designed per-user signed tokens.

projects.name: Paid 1:1 creator video-call platform
projects.summary: Backend, Android app and website for paid per-minute video calls with creators: wallet, payments, payouts, referrals, KYC and admin.
techniques: prepaid per-minute metering with the server as sole authority on time and money
self-hosted APK distribution with SHA-256 release manifests

projects.name: GPS map camera app
projects.summary: A camera app on Google Play that stamps GPS coordinates, address and a map onto photos and videos; taken over as an inherited Flutter app, re-architected to MVVM, then rebuilt natively.
techniques: overlay baked at photo pixel scale so the preview is what gets saved
capture pipeline that survives the app being killed

projects.name: AI email-to-spreadsheet parser
